DELAYED_EXIT_FILL.assumption_summary: Conditional assumption: same entry basis as baseline, but passive F11 reduce-only SELL LIMIT rests in queue for >=2 bars (2h on 1h bars) before filling at its limit when the adverse bid reaches it; reprices downward after cooldown if price drops (up to EXIT_MAX_ATTEMPTS=5).

GAP_AND_CANCEL_FAULT.assumption_summary: Conditional assumption: widened 10 bps half-spread, PERCENT_PRICE [0.97, 1.03] gap block when bar jump exceeds 3%, 1-bar passive exit wait, plus injected cancel UNKNOWN->RECONCILE fault.

IDEAL_LIMIT_FILL.assumption_summary: Conditional assumption: marketable F11 reduce-only SELL LIMIT at the tick-rounded adverse bid fills immediately within bar capacity (0.10 NVDA/bar or bar volume), with 3 bps fee and 2 bps slippage; all real exchange filters & Demo guardrails enforced.

LIMITED_CAPACITY_PARTIAL.assumption_summary: Conditional assumption: executable liquidity capped at 0.02 NVDA/bar (50% of 0.04 lot), same entry price basis as baseline (3 bps fee, 2 bps slippage), forcing multi-bar partial fills and exercising F11 anti-dust / MIN_NOTIONAL protection on <5 USDT remainders.

UNFILLED_EXIT_TIMEOUT.assumption_summary: Conditional assumption: same entry basis as baseline, severe liquidity drought where F11 reduce-only SELL LIMIT orders cannot fill; exercises bounded repricing up to EXIT_MAX_ATTEMPTS=5 then EXIT_RETRY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
